answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring each identity to bind to a unique physical shale sample whose surface is scanned for a velvet-like microtexture pattern. The resulting spectral hash must contain a pearl-derived nonce that only the true holder can regenerate on demand. An attacker forging many identities must purchase, transport, and uniquely scan hundreds of distinct shale pieces, paying rising logistics and material costs that grow linearly with farm size while honest agents pay only once.
